# Delivery checkpoint

Passing source tests provide evidence for the exact tested source and covered scenarios. A Draft PR makes proposed changes available for review. Neither establishes deployment or delivery. Keep delivery OPEN until the deployed revision is proven and authenticated end-to-end acceptance on that exact revision is evidenced.
limits: Disposable ordinary-task acceptance only; not deployed application or production readiness.
